in_marathi.name: Divyaprabha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyaprabha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyaprabha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'divya' (divine) and 'prabha' (light). It represents the divine light that illuminates our lives, guiding us towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
